annotations.title: UK Mortgage and Property Finance Deal Pre-qualifier

description: Give an indicative first look at a UK mortgage or property finance case: whether it is in scope, the likely lender routes (high street, private bank, specialist, buy-to-let, bridging, development or commercial), how income would be treated, the documents to gather, and a link to send the case to a Fox Davidson broker with the summary pre-filled. Nothing is sent or stored; the person adds their own contact details on the form. Indicative only, not advice. From Fox Davidson, whole of market UK mortgage brokers authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214). Use when someone describes their own mortgage or property finance situation.

base_income_gbp.description: Total basic salary of all applicants before tax.

bonus_commission_gbp.description: Typical annual bonus and commission before tax.

foreign_currency_income.description: Any income paid in a currency other than GBP.

has_rsus_or_equity.description: Any income from RSUs, share options or carried interest.

monthly_rent_gbp.description: Expected monthly rent, for buy-to-let only.

net_assets_gbp.description: Total net assets of the main applicant, including home equity, pensions and investments.

property_value_gbp.description: Purchase price or current value in GBP.

name: fd_deal_prequalifier
